content.short: Pocket Universe is a free browser extension that keeps assets safe when you sign web3 transactions.
content.description: Pocket Universe helps protect you on every transaction by warning you when you might be interacting with a malicious activity designed to steal your assets. It detects phishing attempts and risky behaviors, including approval-for-all scams, malicious Seaport transactions, honeypot NFT schemes, and counterfeit tokens. With proactive alerts and clear risk indicators, you can review the details and make informed decisions before you approve, across supported chains such as Ethereum, Polygon, BNB Chain, Avalanche, Solana, Cosmos, and Arbitrum.
content.meta: Pocket Universe is a free browser extension that keeps assets safe on web3 transactions. Discover Pocket Universe and other Web3 apps on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
